题目内容: 设 $A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 \\& 2 \\& & 3 \end{pmatrix}$ 与 $B = \begin{pmatrix} 2\\ & 3\\ & & 1 \end{pmatrix}$ 合同，则合同变换矩阵 $P = (\quad)$ .
解析:
B.

解 依题意, A 的二次型 $f = x_{1}^{2} + 2x_{2}^{2} + 3x_{3}^{2}$ 在可逆线性变换 x = Py 下化为 $f = 2y_{1}^{2} + 3y_{2}^{2} + y_{3}^{2}$ ，故该变换为

$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x _ {1} = 0 y _ {1} + 0 y _ {2} + y _ {3}, \\ x _ {2} = y _ {1} + 0 y _ {2} + 0 y _ {3}, \\ x _ {3} = 0 y _ {1} + y _ {2} + 0 y _ {3}, \end{array} \right.$

即 $\begin{pmatrix}x_{1}\\x_{2}\\x_{3}\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}0&0&1\\1&0&0\\0&1&0\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}y_{1}\\y_{2}\\y_{3}\end{pmatrix}$ ，故 $P=\begin{pmatrix}0&0&1\\1&0&0\\0&1&0\end{pmatrix}$ .

【注】① 若 $f = x^{T}Ax \frac{x = Py}{P \text{ 可逆 }} (Py)^{T}APy = y^{T}P^{T}APy, P^{T}AP = B$ ，则称 A 与 B 合同，x = Py 称为合同变换.

② A, B 合同 $\Leftrightarrow$ A 与 B 的正、负惯性指数分别相等，即 $p_{A} = p_{B}, q_{A} = q_{B}$ .

又 $E_{i,j}^{-1}=E_{i,j},E_{i,j}^{T}=E_{i,j}$ ，故 $B=E_{i,j}AE_{i,j}=E_{i,j}^{-1}AE_{i,j}=E_{i,j}^{T}AE_{i,j}$ ，所以 A 与 B 等价、相似且合同.

A.

解 判定规范形, 只要确定二次型的秩及正、负惯性指数, 可以通过求二次型矩阵 A 的特征值来确定.

$f$ 的矩阵为 $\mathbf{A} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -2 & 2 \\ -2 & 4 & -4 \\ 2 & -4 & 4 \end{bmatrix}$ , 由

$| \lambda E - A | = \lambda^ {2} (\lambda - 9) = 0,$

得 $\lambda_{1}=9,\lambda_{2}=\lambda_{3}=0$ , 所以 $r(A)=1$ , 正惯性指数 p=1 , 负惯性指数 q=0 , 故选项 A 正确.

题目内容: 设 E 是 n 阶单位矩阵, 则 $n(n \text{ 为偶数})$ 阶实对称矩阵 A 正定的充分必要条件是().
选项A: 存在 $n$ 阶矩阵 $C$ , 使得 $A = C^T C$
选项B: 二次型 $X^T A X$ 的负惯性指数为0
选项C: 存在可逆矩阵 P, 使得 $P^{-1}AP = E$
选项D: $A$ 的伴随矩阵 $A^{*}$ 与 $E$ 合同
解析:
D.

解 对于选项 A, 因选项 A 中的矩阵 C 没有可逆的条件, 故由 $A = C^{T}C$ 不能得到 A 与 E 合同, 即 A 不一定正定. 排除选项 A.

对于选项 B, 由 $\mathrm{r}(f)=p+q\leqslant n$ , 知当 q=0 时, 有 $\mathrm{r}(f)=p\leqslant n$ . 此时可能 p<n, 因而 $X^{T}AX$ 不一定是正定二次型, 从而矩阵 A 不一定是正定矩阵, 如 $f(x_{1},x_{2},x_{3})=x_{1}^{2}+x_{2}^{2}$ . 故选项 B 是 A 正定的必要条件, 但不是充分条件, 排除.

对于选项 C, 由 $P^{-1}AP = E$ , 知 A 与 E 相似, 故 A 的特征值全为 1, A 是正定矩阵. 当 A 的特征值全大于零时, A 就是正定矩阵, 而特征值全为 1 是不必要的. 故选项 C 是充分条件, 但不是必要条件, 排除.

对于选项 D, 由于 A 正定 $\Leftrightarrow A^{-1}$ 正定 $\Leftrightarrow A^{*}$ 正定, 而 $A^{*}$ 正定 $\Leftrightarrow A^{*}$ 合同于 E, 所以, 选项 D 正确.

题目内容: 设 $A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 2 & -1 \end{pmatrix}$ , 若存在可逆矩阵 $C$ , 使得 $C^T AC = \Lambda$ , 则 $C$ 可能为 ( ).
解析:
A.

解 存在可逆矩阵 C，使得 $C^{T}AC = \Lambda$ ，对二次型 $X^{T}AX$ 用配方法求矩阵 C。对于二次型

$\begin{array}{r l} f (x _ {1}, x _ {2}, x _ {3}) & = \mathbf {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \mathbf {A} \mathbf {X} = x _ {1} ^ {2} - x _ {3} ^ {2} + 4 x _ {1} x _ {2} + 4 x _ {2} x _ {3} \\ & = (x _ {1} ^ {2} + 4 x _ {1} x _ {2} + 4 x _ {2} ^ {2}) - 4 x _ {2} ^ {2} + 4 x _ {2} x _ {3} - x _ {3} ^ {2} \\ & = (x _ {1} + 2 x _ {2}) ^ {2} - (2 x _ {2} - x _ {3}) ^ {2}, \end{array}$

令 $\left\{\begin{aligned}y_{1}&=x_{1}+2x_{2},\\ y_{2}&=2x_{2}-x_{3},\\ y_{3}&=x_{3},\end{aligned}\right.$ 解得 $\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1}&=y_{1}-y_{2}-y_{3},\\ x_{2}&=\frac{1}{2}(y_{2}+y_{3}),\\ x_{3}&=y_{3},\end{aligned}\right.$ 即 $\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1}\\ x_{2}\\ x_{3}\end{aligned}\right.=\left[\begin{matrix}1&-1&-1\\ 0&\frac{1}{2}&\frac{1}{2}\\ 0&0&1\end{matrix}\right]\left(\begin{aligned}y_{1}\\ y_{2}\\ y_{3}\end{aligned}\right)$ ，故所求的可逆矩阵为

$\boldsymbol {C} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & - 1 & - 1 \\ 0 & \frac {1}{2} & \frac {1}{2} \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right).$

选项 A 正确.

$\mathrm{r} (1 \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A}) = \mathrm{r} \left(\left( \begin{array}{c c} - 1 & - 1 \\ 1 & 1 \end{array} \right)\right) = 1,$

$\mathrm{r} (1 \pmb {E} - \pmb {B}) = \mathrm{r} \left(\left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - 1 \\ 0 & 0 \end{array} \right)\right) = 1,$

$$- \boldsymbol {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {X} < \boldsymbol {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {X} < \boldsymbol {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {X}.$$
由 $-X^{T}X < X^{T}AX$ ，知 $X^{T}(A + E)X > 0.$

又 $A + E$ 为 2 阶实对称矩阵, 故 $A + E$ 为正定矩阵.

同理,由 $X^{T}AX ,知 X^{T}(E-A)X>0 ,故E-A为正定矩阵,有$

$\begin{array}{r l} \binom {\boldsymbol {X} _ {1}} {\boldsymbol {X} _ {2}} ^ {\mathrm{T}} & \left( \begin{array}{c c} \boldsymbol {A} + \boldsymbol {E} & \boldsymbol {O} \\ \boldsymbol {O} & \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A} \end{array} \right) \binom {\boldsymbol {X} _ {1}} {\boldsymbol {X} _ {2}} = (\boldsymbol {X} _ {1} ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \boldsymbol {X} _ {2} ^ {\mathrm{T}}) \left( \begin{array}{c c} \boldsymbol {A} + \boldsymbol {E} & \boldsymbol {O} \\ \boldsymbol {O} & \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A} \end{array} \right) \binom {\boldsymbol {X} _ {1}} {\boldsymbol {X} _ {2}} \\ & = \boldsymbol {X} _ {1} ^ {\mathrm{T}} (\boldsymbol {A} + \boldsymbol {E}) \boldsymbol {X} _ {1} + \boldsymbol {X} _ {2} ^ {\mathrm{T}} (\boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A}) \boldsymbol {X} _ {2}. \end{array}$

当 $X_{1}\neq0,X_{2}\neq0$ 时，

$\boldsymbol {X} _ {1} ^ {\mathrm{T}} (\boldsymbol {A} + \boldsymbol {E}) \boldsymbol {X} _ {1} + \boldsymbol {X} _ {2} ^ {\mathrm{T}} (\boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A}) \boldsymbol {X} _ {2} > 0,$

从而4阶实对称矩阵 $\left( \begin{array}{cc}A + E & O\\ O & E - A \end{array} \right)$ 正定.

所以，二次型的规范形为 $y_{1}^{2} + y_{2}^{2} + y_{3}^{2} + y_{4}^{2}$ ，选项 C 正确.

$\begin{array}{r l} f (x _ {1}, x _ {2}) & = \left| \begin{array}{c c c} 1 - a & a & x _ {1} \\ a & a & x _ {2} \\ - x _ {1} & - x _ {2} & 0 \end{array} \right| = x _ {1} \left| \begin{array}{c c} a & a \\ - x _ {1} & - x _ {2} \end{array} \right| - x _ {2} \left| \begin{array}{c c} 1 - a & a \\ - x _ {1} & - x _ {2} \end{array} \right| \\ & = - a x _ {1} \left| \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 1 \\ x _ {1} & x _ {2} \end{array} \right| + x _ {2} \left| \begin{array}{c c} 1 - a & a \\ x _ {1} & x _ {2} \end{array} \right| \\ & = a x _ {1} (x _ {1} - x _ {2}) + x _ {2} [ (1 - a) x _ {2} - a x _ {1} ] \\ & = a x _ {1} ^ {2} + (1 - a) x _ {2} ^ {2} - 2 a x _ {1} x _ {2}. \end{array}$

题目内容: 若 3 阶实对称矩阵 A 与 $B = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 \end{pmatrix}$ 合同，则二次型 $x^{T}Ax$ 的规范形为 \_\_\_\_.

$-y_{1}^{2}-y_{2}^{2}+y_{3}^{2}.$

解 由 $x^{T}Ax$ 经正交变换下的标准形, 知 A 的特征值为 $\lambda_{1} = \lambda_{2} = 1, \lambda_{3} = -1$ , 且

$| \mathbf {A} | = 1 \times 1 \times (- 1) = - 1.$

又 $A^{*}$ 的特征值为 $\frac{|A|}{\lambda_{1}} = -1, \frac{|A|}{\lambda_{2}} = -1, \frac{|A|}{\lambda_{3}} = 1$ ，故 $p_{A^{*}} = 1, q_{A^{*}} = 2$ ，所以 $x^{T}A^{*}x$ 的规范形为 $-y_{1}^{2} - y_{2}^{2} + y_{3}^{2}$ .

【注】① A 是可逆实对称矩阵, 则 $A^{-1}, A^{*}$ 都是实对称矩阵.

② 在讨论正、负惯性指数时，应掌握惯性定理：二次型 f 经可逆线性变换，其正、负惯性指数不变，且 $p + q = \mathrm{r}(f)$ ，其秩 $\mathrm{r}(f)$ 也不变.

$\begin{array}{r l} \left| \boldsymbol {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {A} ^ {*} \boldsymbol {X} - \boldsymbol {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {X} \right| & = \left| \boldsymbol {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} (\boldsymbol {A} ^ {*} - \boldsymbol {A}) \boldsymbol {X} \right| \\ & \xlongequal {\boldsymbol {X} = \boldsymbol {Q Y}} \left| (1 2 - 2) y _ {1} ^ {2} + (8 - 3) y _ {2} ^ {2} + (6 - 4) y _ {3} ^ {2} \right| \\ & = \left| 1 0 y _ {1} ^ {2} + 5 y _ {2} ^ {2} + 2 y _ {3} ^ {2} \right| \leqslant 1 0 (y _ {1} ^ {2} + y _ {2} ^ {2} + y _ {3} ^ {2}) = 1 0 \boldsymbol {Y} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {Y}. \end{array}$

$\left| \boldsymbol {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {A} ^ {*} \boldsymbol {X} - \boldsymbol {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {X} \right| \leqslant a \boldsymbol {Y} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {Y}.$

解（Ⅰ）二次型的矩阵为 $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&1&a\\1&a&-1\-a&-1&1\end{pmatrix}$ . 由于已知 $p+q=2=r(A)$ ，故 $|A|=-(a-1)^{2}(a+2)=0,$

$\begin{array}{r l} f (x _ {1}, x _ {2}, x _ {3}) & = x _ {1} ^ {2} + 2 x _ {1} (x _ {2} + 2 x _ {3}) + (x _ {2} + 2 x _ {3}) ^ {2} - (x _ {2} + 2 x _ {3}) ^ {2} - 2 x _ {2} ^ {2} + x _ {3} ^ {2} - 2 x _ {2} x _ {3} \\ & = (x _ {1} + x _ {2} + 2 x _ {3}) ^ {2} - 3 x _ {2} ^ {2} - 6 x _ {2} x _ {3} - 3 x _ {3} ^ {2} \\ & = (x _ {1} + x _ {2} + 2 x _ {3}) ^ {2} - 3 (x _ {2} ^ {2} + 2 x _ {2} x _ {3} + x _ {3} ^ {2}) \\ & = (x _ {1} + x _ {2} + 2 x _ {3}) ^ {2} - 3 (x _ {2} + x _ {3}) ^ {2}. \end{array}$

故 $\mathbf{A} = Q\Lambda Q^{-1} = Q\Lambda Q^{\mathrm{T}}$ ，从而有

$\begin{array}{r l} \boldsymbol {Q} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {A} ^ {*} \boldsymbol {Q} & = \boldsymbol {Q} ^ {\mathrm{T}} (\boldsymbol {Q} \boldsymbol {\Lambda} \boldsymbol {Q} ^ {\mathrm{T}}) ^ {*} \boldsymbol {Q} = \boldsymbol {Q} ^ {\mathrm{T}} (\boldsymbol {Q} ^ {*}) ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\Lambda} ^ {*} \boldsymbol {Q} ^ {*} \boldsymbol {Q} \\ & = (\boldsymbol {Q} ^ {*} \boldsymbol {Q}) ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\Lambda} ^ {*} (\boldsymbol {Q} ^ {*} \boldsymbol {Q}) = (| \boldsymbol {Q} | \boldsymbol {E}) ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\Lambda} ^ {*} (| \boldsymbol {Q} | \boldsymbol {E}) \\ & = \boldsymbol {E} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\Lambda} ^ {*} \boldsymbol {E} = \boldsymbol {\Lambda} ^ {*}. \end{array}$
